changelog: Delete C8 — remove the appositive/identification principle because it largely duplicates C7 (post-nominal modifiers) and splits the judge's attention; this pruning follows the 'prune' constraint and focuses the prompt on the primary finding about short predicate complements.

Insert a narrow surface-binding principle after C3 to keep a verb/copula together with an immediately following 1–4-word prepositional/temporal/locative/measurement complement — addresses the primary finding that cutting there produces orphaned or contradicting fragments.
Deleted six largest v0 Examples (E2, E11, E6, E1, E10, E4) to meet the size budget and remove weak, lengthy hand-written cases.
Paraphrased C8 to a much shorter wording while preserving the measurement checklist (reduces prompt length).

Inserted a new Core Principle (after C2): a positive binding that keeps a 1–4-word short prepositional/temporal/locative/measurement phrase together with an immediately preceding verb or copula — addresses the primary finding without phrasing a prohibitory rule.
